blocks.x: Intelligent Process Automation at Scale in production terms — the runtime that holds it, the policies that bound it, the dashboards that prove it, and the quarterly delta your finance team can bank.
The problem this solution exists for
RPA estates fragment across kingdoms; agents arrive ungoverned; nobody knows which automation did what; conformance drifts.
Our approach
We mine the process truth first, build the automation spine (events, APIs, RPA, agents under one control plane), stage rollouts with replay evaluation, and keep conformance measured quarterly.
